Venezuela ADM1 boundaries

Source: OCHA Venezuela / Instituto Nacional de Estadística, distributed by geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab).
Dataset: VEN-ADM1-42786344, 25 administrative regions, year represented: 2020.
Pinned geoBoundaries revision: 9469f09; build date: December 12, 2023.
File: geoBoundaries-VEN-ADM1_simplified.geojson (bundled without geometry changes).
Source metadata: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/VEN/ADM1/
Original source: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/venezuela-administrative-level-0-1-and-2-boundaries
Download: https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/VEN/ADM1/geoBoundaries-VEN-ADM1_simplified.geojson
